newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MARADONA LOOKS FIT ENOUGH FOR TOP FLIGHT-MENOTTI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARADONA LOOKS FIT ENOUGH FOR TOP FLIGHT-MENOTTI.

text.p: Former World Cup star Diego Maradona could still earn a recall to the Argentine national side and may still be good enough to return to Italy's serie A, former Argentina coach Cesar Menotti said on Friday.

"If he carries on playing the way he's doing at the moment, I have no doubt he can play for Argentina again, or for Milan, or Juventus or Sampdoria," said World-Cup winning trainer Menotti, who now coaches Sampdoria.
"But it all depends on him. It depends if he has the enthusiasm and the will power."
Menotti, who arrived in Italy last week from his native Argentina where he saw Maradona in action for Boca Juniors, said the 36-year-old looked happier and fitter than he had for a long time.
"He's made an enormous sacrifice to get back into football. He's lost 11 kilos, not by starving himself but through training and hard work."
"A Maradona on top form is good for everyone. When he plays well, you can feel something special in the air," said Menotti, currently at a training camp with Sampdoria in the Italian Alps.
Asked whether he could envisage Maradona playing for Sampdoria, he said: "Diego is always welcome here. If he were standing right here, I'd take him like a shot. Who wouldn't?"
Maradona, who played in serie A with Napoli in the mid-1980's, has effectively been out of regular professional football since he tested positive for drugs at the 1994 World Cup finals.
He recently made a comeback for Buenos Aires side Boca where he started his career. REUTER
